items.name: Trident with 50 feet of line
items.description: This three-pronged, spear-like weapon typically has a 4-foot shaft. Like a spear, it can be wielded with one hand or thrown.

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

generalAbilities.name: Deep Breath
generalAbilities.description: A tidewater guard can hold their breath for 20 minutes.

generalAbilities.name: Tethered Tridents
generalAbilities.description: The tidewater guard's tridents are specially prepared to be aquadynamic and tethered by ropes. They have the tethered trait, meaning that a wielder who has a free hand can Interact to pull the weapon back into their grasp after they have thrown it as a ranged attack or after it has been disarmed (unless it is being held by another creature).

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Reel In
offensiveAbilities.description: The tidewater guard makes a ranged Strike with their trident. If the Strike hits, the guard can haul on the attached line, moving the target up to 30 feet in a straight line toward the iruxi.

offensiveAbilities.name: Terrain Advantage
offensiveAbilities.description: Non-lizardfolk creatures that are in difficult terrain or are in water and lack a swim Speed are Off-Guard to the tidewater guard.
